api_setup_subtitle: Manage your API ID and API Hash
api_setup_guide_title: Obtain API ID & Hash via my.telegram.org
api_setup_error_empty: API ID and API Hash are required.
how_to_get_step1_desc: Open the official Telegram portal and sign in with your Telegram account phone number.
how_to_get_step2_desc: Telegram will send the verification code to your Telegram app (in the official service chat, not via SMS).
how_to_get_step3_desc: Once logged in, click the 'API development tools' section on your account dashboard.
how_to_get_step4_desc: Fill in the App title (e.g. AutoGram) and Short name (e.g. autogram), then click 'Create application'.
how_to_get_step5_desc: Copy your App api_id (number) and App api_hash (32-character string) into the input fields beside.
how_to_get_tip: Your credentials are stored securely encrypted on your local device via Encrypted Store.
